actionConfiguration.body:
select
a.artikel,
a.betrag AS betrag_raw,
to_char(a.betrag, 'FM€ 999G999G999D00') AS Betrag,
k.aname kategorie,
 a.fk_kategorie_sid,
a.datum,
ko.aname konto,
 a.fk_konto_sid,
to_char(date_trunc('month', a.monat)::date, 'FMMonth YY') monat
from ausgabe a
inner join kategorie k on a.fk_kategorie_sid = k.sid and k.fk_recordstate_sid = 0
inner join konto ko on a.fk_konto_sid = ko.sid and ko.fk_recordstate_sid = 0
where a.fk_recordstate_sid = 0 and a.monat = date_trunc('month', {{DatePicker_month.selectedDate}}::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date;
